_meta.purpose: Mood suggestion catalog. A mood is FREE TEXT in the backend — `current_feeling` is stored verbatim and `mood_influence` is applied verbatim (app/core/activity_engine.py -> apply_effects), and nothing validates either against this list; app/core/expression_pose_maps.py resolves whatever text arrives onto an expression key. So this file is the curated list the ADMIN UI offers, not a vocabulary: it is the single source for the mood picker in the character placement editor and for the mood chips in the effects editor, served by GET /admin/shared-lists/moods (app/routes/shared_lists.py). Adding a mood: append an entry here, then add the same id as a key to each shared/languages/*.json with the localized label. Order is the display order.

schema.id: canonical English identifier — used as the value of mood_influence and current_feeling
schema.label_de: OPTIONAL German label for reference; UI rendering looks the label up in shared/languages/<lang>.json, where the ids are the keys verbatim
